title: Our Future Health — Genotype array data — SNV kinship — warning checks
description: Non-blocking checks for the snv_kinship table, from plausibility ranges the source does not state (D127). A finding is a warning for analysts and data providers: it never rejects a row and never changes data. Run tools/warn.py; the main schema and tools/validate.py are unaffected.

allOf.$comment: Warning G01: HetHet is expected to be between 0 and 1 (it is a fraction of markers); a value outside that range may point to a data problem.
Warning G02: IBS0 is expected to be between 0 and 1 (it is a fraction of markers); a value outside that range may point to a data problem.
Warning G03: Kinship is expected to be at most 0.5 (a kinship coefficient cannot exceed 0.5); a value outside that range may point to a data problem.
